versions.content: In case TcpIp_RequestIpAddrAssignment() is called with parameter Type set to TCPIP_IPADDR_ASSIGNMENT_STATIC and no TcpIpStaticIpAddressConfig container is con figured for the LocalAddr specified by parameter LocalAddrId, TcpIp shall assign the IP address, netmask and default router specified by parameter LocalIpAddrPtr, Netmask and DefaultRouterPtr as soon as TCPIP_STATE_ONLINE is requested or immediately if alr eady requested.
